source: TomorrowX Summit (iConnections) — Opening session: retail as most powerful market force, AI buildout railroad vs telecom, P(doom) vs P(boom)
summary: A bubble in AI is not the current state, but is the key risk to avoid; no bubble currently
summary_extended: Baker asserts that AI is not currently in a bubble, framing bubble avoidance as the single most important risk for investors who are bullish on AI. He draws an analogy to historical infrastructure buildouts — comparing AI to railroads rather than telecom — suggesting the current pace of capital deployment is more measured and therefore less prone to the speculative excess that characterized the dot-com era. The slower buildout dynamic, in his view, reduces the probability of a bubble forming in the near term, even as he acknowledges it remains the key tail risk to monitor. No specific valuation metrics or price targets were cited to support the assertion; the claim rests on a qualitative structural comparison rather than quantitative evidence.
detail: Baker explicitly states 'we're certainly not in a bubble right now' and frames bubble avoidance as the paramount concern for AI bulls. The slower buildout dynamic reduces bubble risk.
confidence_evidence: Stated as a direct assertion but without detailed valuation support in this transcript
